data.close_reason: The premise no longer holds. compose_startup_opcert_binding binds the on-box MCP signer from REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID + REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY, and _opcert_signing.py:176-178 specifies that a bound signer uses its process-owned key copy verbatim WITHOUT reading REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH -- so that variable is unreachable on this deployment and setting it is a no-op. Change 2328 was abandoned for exactly that reason. The real defect (sign and verify resolving the key from different places) was fixed on d26a by change 2337 (83edf9972728) and live-validated as certified. Confirmed on the running container rebar-mcp-25ea12c200ae-8092: REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH is unset, REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY resolves to an existing /run/secrets/opcert-ed25519-key, and the server signs and verifies correctly.
